description: We are ALPHELYRA, a team of ambitious and curious students from Batman Anatolian High School, Türkiye. Driven by science, technology, and innovation, we aim to explore real-world challenges through creative thinking, research, and collaboration. Our vision is to turn ideas into impactful solutions by combining our passion for space, technology, and problem-solving. We are looking for motivated teammates who share our curiosity and enthusiasm for discovering the unknown.
summary:
Diaries of the Abandoned is an interactive web experience that turns the abandoned human-made spacecraft on the Moon and Mars into a story people can explore. The project covers five historic missions: the Apollo 11 Lunar Module, the Viking 1 lander, the Opportunity rover, the InSight lander, and the Ingenuity Mars helicopter. Each chapter combines a first-person diary narrative written from the spacecraft’s perspective, NASA archive photographs, rotatable 3D models, and a landing-site map built on NASA Trek imagery. Short “Kid Explorer” sections explain science concepts in plain language, such as why Apollo footprints have not eroded and why Mars looks red.

The project’s significance lies in making the scientific and historical legacy of space exploration accessible and engaging. It argues that these machines should be preserved as cultural monuments, much as archaeological sites are. By pairing scientific content with storytelling, it aims to spark interest in STEM among young people and raise awareness of humanity’s first footprints beyond Earth.
details:
Diaries of the Abandoned is a web-based interactive experience that brings five abandoned spacecraft on the Moon and Mars to life: the Apollo 11 Lunar Module, the Viking 1 lander, the Opportunity rover, the InSight lander, and the Ingenuity helicopter. Visitors scroll through a series of chapters. Each chapter tells the spacecraft’s story in a first-person diary entry, and pairs it with NASA archive photographs, a 3D model the visitor can rotate and zoom, a map of the landing site, an audio narration of the diary, and a “Kid Explorer” panel that explains a related science idea in plain language. The page also changes its background between the Moon and Mars as the visitor moves through the story.

The project offers several benefits. It turns scattered archival material into one free, engaging journey that works on both phones and computers. The 3D models and landing-site maps let visitors explore the hardware and the terrain themselves, rather than only reading about them. The short science explanations make concepts such as the lack of erosion on the Moon or the cause of Mars’s red color accessible to younger audiences, and the audio narration makes the content available to visitors who prefer listening.

The intended impact is to spark curiosity about space science, especially among young people who may not yet see it as a field for them, and to raise public awareness of the historical and scientific value of these spacecraft. The project also argues that abandoned spacecraft are cultural heritage, comparable to archaeological sites on Earth, and that they deserve to be preserved as humanity’s first monuments beyond our planet.

The project was built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Three.js renders the animated background planet, Google’s model-viewer component displays the 3D hardware, and Leaflet displays the landing-site maps using NASA Solar System Trek map tiles. Background music is generated in the browser with the Web Audio API, and Google Fonts provides the typography.

In developing the project, the team considered accessibility and usability. The site respects visitors’ reduced-motion settings, continues to work when advanced graphics are unavailable, adapts to small phone screens, and shows a clear message if a 3D model fails to load. Audio is off by default so that visitors can browse quietly in any setting. The writing gives the spacecraft a personal voice, which makes the content memorable without sacrificing accuracy.

Source code: https://github.com/yildiz-huseyin/diaries-of-the-abandoned/
